title: Exploit Session Proposal
description: Wraps a single assessment record to propose for an exploit session. Pick the most specific type for the content being submitted.

type.description: Record type being proposed. Must match the schema of payload: 'finding_record' for a confirmed vuln, 'probe_run' for a single probe result, 'attack_chain' for a multi-step chain, 'credential' for captured credentials, 'access_record' for a gained access entry.

payload.description: The record body conforming to the schema named by type.
